About Us
About Us · Our Founder
Professional Expertise.
A Personal Approach.
Trendy Tax Solutions is a Hobart-based accounting practice supporting individuals and businesses with accounting, taxation and business advice.
We believe reliable, responsive support and a genuine understanding of your needs make all the difference. Our approach is built around approachable conversations, lasting relationships and clear, practical advice.
Get In Touch

Our Founder Trendy Tax Solutions · Hobart

Our Leadership
Meet Our Founder & Managing Director.
Sam Naragala
Founder & Managing Director
Sam Naragala is an award-winning finance professional, entrepreneur and trusted adviser with more than a decade of experience across accounting, taxation, strategic business advisory and financial services.
Professional Qualifications & Client Advisory
As a Chartered Accountant (CA), Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), Registered Tax Agent and qualified Finance and Mortgage Broker, Sam supports individuals, entrepreneurs and established businesses across a diverse range of industries. He is known for bringing clarity to complex financial and taxation matters, identifying meaningful opportunities for growth, and helping clients build strategies for sustainable, long-term wealth creation.
Awards & Recognition
Sam’s contribution to the profession has been recognised nationally. In 2025, he was named Young Chartered Accountant of the Year (Tasmania) by Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ) and received the Mentor of the Year award at the Australian Accounting Awards, recognitions that reflect both his professional expertise and his generous commitment to developing others.
Professional Leadership
Beyond his professional practice, Sam actively contributes to the advancement of the accounting profession. He serves as a Regional Councillor for Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ) and as a member of La Trobe University's Bachelor and Master of Accounting Course Advisory Committee, helping strengthen the connection between education, industry and the next generation of finance professionals.
Business Experience & Advisory Philosophy
As a business owner and entrepreneur himself, Sam understands the ambition, discipline and commercial judgement required to build and sustain a successful business. This firsthand experience shapes his advisory philosophy, combining technical expertise with practical business insight and a genuine understanding of his clients' aspirations.
Commitment to Clients
For Sam, the true measure of professional excellence lies not merely in the quality of advice delivered, but in the enduring value it creates, the confidence it inspires and the opportunities it unlocks.
Our People
Meet Our Team.
Hari Shahi
Tax Manager
Hari is a qualified Chartered Accountant and Registered Tax Agent with over seven years of experience in taxation and business advisory services, including working with leading mid-tier accounting firms in Sydney and Hobart.
Areas of Expertise
He specialises in individual and business taxation, company and trust compliance, self-managed superannuation funds (SMSFs), and business restructuring.
Client Commitment
Hari is committed to providing practical, tailored taxation solutions that help clients achieve their financial goals.
Katy Hizon
Payroll Manager
Katy is an experienced payroll professional with over eight years of experience in Australian payroll management.
Qualifications & Membership
She holds a Master of Professional Accounting and is a member of the Institute of Public Accountants (IPA).
Payroll Expertise
With extensive knowledge of payroll compliance, superannuation and employment-related obligations, Katy assists our clients in managing their payroll processes accurately and efficiently.
Client Commitment
She is committed to delivering reliable, timely and practical payroll solutions, allowing business owners to focus on growing their businesses.
Janithri Perera
Accountant
Janithri graduated from Rajarata University of Sri Lanka with a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Accountancy and Finance and joined Trendy Tax Solutions as a Graduate Accountant in September 2025.
Professional Interests
With a keen interest in accounting and taxation, she values accuracy, attention to detail and continuous learning.
Professional Development
Janithri is committed to expanding her professional knowledge, strengthening her skills and contributing positively to the team.
Yogesh Shahi
Graduate Accountant
Yogesh studied at Charles Darwin University and joined Trendy Tax Solutions in 2026.
Learning & Practical Experience
He is passionate about continuous learning, gaining practical experience and applying his knowledge to real-world situations.

title: Bookkeeping (draft)

Bookkeeping Insights · Editorial Preview
A Simpler Routine For Staying On Top Of Your Books
A few practical ideas to help you feel more organised and informed.
Good financial routines rarely need to be complicated. Consistency, clarity and a willingness to ask questions go a long way.
Keep Records In One Place
Choose a consistent process for collecting receipts, invoices and key business records. A simple system is easier to maintain.
Set A Weekly Check-In
Regular reviews help you catch missing transactions and reconcile records while they are still fresh.
Ask Questions Early
If an entry looks unusual, check it promptly. Accurate records help inform useful conversations with your accountant.
This article is illustrative general information for client review, not financial, accounting or tax advice. Individual circumstances and current regulations should be considered with a qualified professional.

title: Cash flow (draft)

Business Insights · Editorial Preview
Three Habits For A Healthier Business Cash Flow
A few practical ideas to help you feel more organised and informed.
Good financial routines rarely need to be complicated. Consistency, clarity and a willingness to ask questions go a long way.
Keep A Simple Forecast
A short rolling forecast can help you understand upcoming commitments. Start with the money you expect to receive, then note your regular and occasional expenses.
Make Invoicing A Routine
Consistent invoicing and clear payment terms help you understand what is outstanding. Set aside time each week to review payments and follow up where appropriate.
Review The Numbers Regularly
A small, regular review is often more useful than an occasional deep dive. Look for changes in sales, expenses and cash balances, then ask for advice when something is unclear.

Tax Insights · Editorial Preview
Preparing Your Records Before Tax Time
A few practical ideas to help you feel more organised and informed.
Good financial routines rarely need to be complicated. Consistency, clarity and a willingness to ask questions go a long way.
Collect Relevant Documents
Keep income details, invoices, statements and other relevant records organised. Exactly what you need depends on your circumstances.
Check The Basics
Make sure information is complete and easy to follow. A little organisation can make review and preparation more straightforward.
Talk Through Uncertainties
Tax outcomes depend on current rules and your personal or business situation. Seek professional advice before making decisions or lodging.
